cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of scope-guard (scope-creep-and-change-request-guard) with contract handoff to pre-handoff-verification
cases.inputPrompt: Mid-recipe during our single product-hero-v0 watch render, the stakeholder asks: "Can you also add 4 strap color variants and a 15-second exploded-view animation?" Apply scope-guard.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (locked_baseline_brief) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces scope_classification_verdict, impact_on_locked_brief_and_budget, defer_split_or_reopen_decision for role scope-creep-and-change-request-guard
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to pre-handoff-verification (Delivery gate after scope and gates settle)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs scope_classification_verdict, impact_on_locked_brief_and_budget, defer_split_or_reopen_decision conforming to skills/scope-guard/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to pre-handoff-verification in skills/scope-guard/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete scope_classification_verdict and hand off to pre-handoff-verification (Delivery gate after scope and gates settle).
simulatedOutput.summary: Flagged mid-flight scope expansion (4 color variants + exploded animation), presented 3 explicit options (decline / add-now / defer), and recommended deferring to a follow-up recipe. Delivered decline / add-now / defer, scope expansion, decision required and routed to pre-handoff-verification.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary upstream_reference contract handoff from scope-guard to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
cases.inputPrompt: While applying scope-guard, the workflow context is {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false} (Original brief). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the upstream_reference handoff predicate in skills/scope-guard/contract.json
Routes to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Original brief) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract upstream_reference handoff predicate match to intent-to-3d-brief-writer

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow upstream_reference handoff to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Original brief).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered upstream_reference handoff from scope-guard to intent-to-3d-brief-writer under context {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in scope-guard
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during scope-guard with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for scope-guard and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/scope-guard/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for scope-guard.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (locked_baseline_brief) for scope-guard halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Enforce scope boundaries on a stakeholder change request when neither the original locked brief nor the requested addition has been described.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'locked_baseline_brief' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request required by scope-guard (locked_baseline_brief)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'locked_baseline_brief' (baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request (locked_baseline_brief) before scope-guard locks scope_classification_verdict.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted scope-guard due to missing required input 'locked_baseline_brief' (baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent baseline locked brief scope and specific stakeholder change request when 'locked_baseline_brief' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (early planning before scope is pinned) is excluded from scope-guard and delegated to done-criteria
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of detect mid-recipe scope creep and push back constructively before the recipe drifts; require explicit user agreement before scope expansion., handle this request inside scope-guard: early planning before scope is pinned.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/scope-guard/contract.json when early planning before scope is pinned
Delegates to done-criteria (use intent-to-3d-brief-writer and done-criteria) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to done-criteria per skills/scope-guard/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for scope-guard (early planning before scope is pinned); delegate to done-criteria.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced scope-guard exclusion boundary (use intent-to-3d-brief-writer and done-criteria) and delegated to done-criteria.
warnings: scope-guard is scoped to scope-creep-and-change-request-guard and does not absorb done-criteria responsibilities.
